text: 与哺乳动物和植物不同，这里的鸟类颇为常见：燕鸥、杓鹬和鹅。你们穿过一片莎草、灯心草和芦苇丛生的沼泽时，你想到“纳德尔曼失落之地”或许不会为鸟类学增添多少新物种。
然而你错了。一声有力而刺耳的啼叫惊动了你们。一颗脑袋从沼泽植物间猛地探出。这像是一种鸟，高如鸵鸟，颈部与胸肌却更为粗壮。它的利爪又长又弯，喙像鹰一样。这是一只巨型食肉鸟！看起来足以杀死并吞食一头野牛。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 315
text: Unlike the mammal and plant life, the bird population contains species quite familiar to you—terns, curlews, and geese. As you cross a slough heavily grown with sedge, rushes, and reeds, you reflect that “Nadelmann’s Lost Land” may not add many new species to the science of ornithology.

But, you are mistaken. A powerful, harsh caw startles the two of you. A head stabs out from the swamp growth. It is some form of bird, as tall as an ostrich, but with a heavier neck and breast muscles. Its talons are long and curved, its beak similar to an eagle’s. A giant carnivorous bird! It looks like it could kill and eat a buffalo.
